name: Retries
description: Retries per failure class. Each attempt is recorded with recordAttempt: a success, or a failure of a class the config names, which counts against that class's cap and a total cap. A terminal class, a failure past a cap, or the same failure signature repeated stuckAfter times exhausts the instance, and its Workflow status moves to exhaustedState from the config's from states through Workflow's transition. Once exhausted, its status moves only to exhaustedState and its lease cannot be taken. A kept result, the best scoring one when keepBest is given, is written to resultField with the checks of an update. There is no backoff in time. Requires Workflow.

attempts.description: How many failures of the class an instance may have.

backoff.description: How long the row waits after a failure of the class before it runs again: firstMs after its first failure of the class since its last success, factor times longer after each next one, never longer than maxMs. The failure sets the row's retryAt; until then a transition into a state of retryInto, and Lease's acquire, are vetoed backing_off. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

factor.description: How many times longer each next wait is; 2 when absent.

firstMs.description: The wait after the first failure, in milliseconds.

maxMs.description: The longest wait, in milliseconds, at least firstMs.

hint.description: What recordAttempt returns for a failure of the class, to steer the worker's next attempt.

classes.description: The failure classes, by name: each its own cap of attempts, with an optional hint for the next attempt, or terminal, which exhausts the instance at its first failure.

exhaustedState.description: The state of the type's Workflow an exhausted instance moves to.

from.description: The states exhaustion moves the status from; every state but the terminal ones and exhaustedState when absent. A transition from each to exhaustedState must exist.

giveUpAfterMs.description: Exhausts the row at its first failed attempt this many milliseconds or more after the first failure since its last success (failingSince), however much room its caps have left. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

keepBest.description: Keeps the best scoring result rather than only a success's: a failed attempt's result is kept when its score beats the best kept one by at least minDelta and no neverRegress predicate that held for the kept one fails.

minDelta.description: How much a score must beat the best kept one by; any amount above it when absent.

neverRegress.description: Predicates an attempt reports that a kept result never loses: one true for the kept result must be true for the next one kept.

keyField.description: An own field whose value keys every class's count: an attempt under another value than the last starts the counts, the total, exhaustion and the wait again, so { attempts: 1 } with keyField: "version" is one failure per version. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

limitsField.description: An object field of the type with the instance's own caps: a class's name to a cap of at least 0, and totalAttempts to a total of at least 1. An unknown or terminal class, and a value that is not such an integer, is ignored. Once the instance exists, only a principal with limitsPermission changes it, and the holder of its active lease does not.

limitsPermission.description: The permission a principal needs to change limitsField once the instance exists. Absent, the caps an instance is created with do not change.

permission.description: The permission a principal needs to record an attempt. Absent, any principal who may write the instance can.

resultField.description: A field of the type a kept result is written to, with the checks of an update.

retryInto.description: The states of the Workflow an attempt starts in: a transition into one waits until the row's retryAt has passed (backing_off) and for room in window (throttled), as Lease's acquire does. Needs a class with a backoff, or window. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

status.description: The field of the type whose Workflow exhaustedState, from, retryInto and then name states of. Implied when the type has one Workflow; needed when it has several. A Workflow anchored on the type is named Workflow. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

stuckAfter.description: How many failures in a row, none of them kept, with the same signature exhaust the instance as stuck.

then.description: Moves the row's Workflow status when its backoff ends: a deadline armed at retryAt moves it to transition, through Workflow's transition, while the status is one of from; a move a guard vetoes, or that the deadline's caller may not make, leaves the status as it is. Needs a class with a backoff. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

totalAttempts.description: How many failures of every class together an instance may have.

window.description: Caps the attempts the row records in any ms milliseconds: while attempts of them fall in the last ms, a transition into a state of retryInto, and Lease's acquire, are vetoed throttled until the oldest of them leaves the window. An attempt that ran is recorded whatever the window holds. Each attempt's time is a row of the attempts sub-table. Needs retryInto, or Lease on the type. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

attempts.description: How many attempts the window holds.

ms.description: How long the window is, in milliseconds.

fields.name: bestScore
fields.description: The score of the kept result; absent when no scored result is kept.

fields.name: exhausted
fields.description: Whether the instance has run out of attempts.

fields.name: stuck
fields.description: Whether the instance failed with the same signature stuckAfter times in a row.

fields.name: retryAt
fields.description: When the row may run again after its last failure, in epoch milliseconds, as its class's backoff gives it; absent when it may run at once. A table's alone: an engine type keeps none.

fields.name: failingSince
fields.description: When the first failure since the row's last success was recorded, in epoch milliseconds, which giveUpAfterMs counts from; absent after a success, and without giveUpAfterMs. A table's alone: an engine type keeps none.

fields.name: keyedBy
fields.description: The value of keyField the counts were made under, as text; absent without keyField. A table's alone: an engine type keeps none.

tables.name: attempts
tables.description: One row per attempt the row recorded, keyed by its number, the order they were recorded in: when, its failure class (absent for a success), its score, whether its result was kept, its signature, its predicates and its detail, who recorded it, and the keyField value it counted under. The window, stuckAfter's streak, keepBest's neverRegress and a backoff's wait read it.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The attempt's number on the row, from 1 in the order they were recorded, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was recorded, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: failure
fields.description: Its failure class; absent for a success.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Its score; absent when it gave none.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: What identified its failure, for stuckAfter.

fields.name: predicates
fields.description: The named checks it passed or failed, for keepBest's neverRegress.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: What recordAttempt was told about it, as it was given.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject of the caller who recorded it.

fields.name: keyedBy
fields.description: The value of keyField it counted under, as text; absent without keyField.

operations.name: recordAttempt
operations.description: Records an attempt: a success without failure, or a failure of one of the config's classes, counted against its caps, and returns the class's hint. Decides whether its result is kept, and writes a kept result to resultField. Exhausts the instance at a terminal class, a failure past a cap or a stuck signature, moving its status to exhaustedState from the from states. Refused once the instance is exhausted, and without the config's permission.

detail.description: Anything about the attempt worth keeping, such as validation errors: recorded in the operation's event and nowhere else.

failure.description: The failure class; a success when absent.

predicates.description: Named checks the attempt passed or failed, for keepBest's neverRegress; a predicate absent here counts as failed.

result.description: The attempt's result, written to resultField when it is kept; needs resultField.

score.description: The attempt's score; higher is better.

signature.description: What identifies the failure, for stuckAfter: the same signature in a row is the same failure.

classAttempts.description: Failures counted so far, by class.

failure.description: The failure class; null for a success.

hint.description: The failure class's hint; null for a success and a class without one.

kept.description: Whether the attempt's result was kept.

retryAt.description: When the row may run again, as its class's backoff gives it; absent when it may run at once. A table's alone: an engine type answers none.

stuck.description: Whether a repeated signature exhausted the instance.

vetoes.description: The instance's retries are exhausted: it takes no more attempts, its status moves only to exhaustedState, and it is not acquired or claimed again.
The holder of the instance's active lease does not change limitsField: a worker never raises its own caps.
The config names no limitsPermission, so limitsField does not change once the instance exists.

A transition into a state of retryInto, or Lease's acquire, before the row's retryAt: its last attempt failed in a class with a backoff; details give retryAt. A table's alone: an engine type refuses backoff.
A transition into a state of retryInto, or Lease's acquire, while the window holds its attempts; details give until, when the oldest leaves it. A table's alone: an engine type refuses window.
